about: Card 10C-1b: 150 synthetic Japanese chart lines for measuring a morphological analyser's person-name tagging inside the privacy guard, written before any measurement and committed before the harness first ran on them. Licence: written for this repository and released under its licence; every line is invented, none comes from a record. Names are invented: surnames 見本 (sample), 架空 (fictional), 仮名 (pseudonym), 模擬 (mock), 例 and 試, or an ordinary surname and an ordinary given name drawn separately and paired here; any likeness to a real person is coincidental. No hospital is named: hospital and clinic names are invented (見本, 架空) or a place name alone. `names`: 75 lines with a name that has no label, honorific or title beside it (kanji, katakana, with and without an age or a sex); every string in `ids` must be fully masked. `ordinary`: 75 ordinary clinical lines chosen to tempt a name tagger (eponymous diseases, signs and procedures, drug names in katakana, place names in hospital and department names, doctors' titles without a name, family-role words); none may be changed.
